parsed.internal_thinking: Ziv is right to be frustrated. The robber on hex 14 is blocking both his city and my settlement, which means every 9 that rolls is a huge waste for us while Shon collects wheat from his other 9. I should agree with Ziv to keep our shared interest in moving the robber aligned. I have the resources for my next settlement at 35, but I'll need that wheat flow back soon.
